goal: Surface UNK AI resurrection anchors for football season
body: Shard grep identified the canonical UNK AI lineage. Primary anchor: shard 17319 db2, UNK = Cognitive Orchestrator with a six tier cognitive system and Firestore RAG. Fleet README shard 17748 db7 points to Who-Visions/unk-app-ai and describes Unk Agent as Cognitive Tiers / high level reasoning optimization. Runtime configs preserve Cloud Run unk-agent-574321322006 with legacy /chat and later /v1/chat/completions surfaces. A migrated code reference confirms unk-app-ai/gemini_agent/models_spec.py and deploy_unk_fleet.py, including Gemini 3 thinking levels, Interactions API constants, embeddings, and thought signature support. Football doctrine is separate but compatible: shard 22028 db6 says American football is NouGen's master field model, GM, Stadium, Coach, Player, Quarterback, Playbook, Keymaker, Scoreboard, with shard 16743 cited as literal positional playbook implementation. Do not conflate UNK AI with the separate local unk_trader_vault Flutter/Firestore trading application. No shard found yet proving UNK was historically an NFL specific agent, so football specialization should be treated as a resurrection extension rather than recovered canon.
